description: When the user asks for a payment check, checks a proposed AI-agent payment against the person's mandate (who allowed it, limits per payment and per period, allowed shops and UPI IDs, end date) and against what the person actually asked for (items, quantities, budget, shop). It works the total out again from the cart lines, and flags lookalike payees, extra items, too much quantity, going over a limit and repeat payments. Returns every check and a receipt signed by Nityaflow. It never pays, holds or moves money: a licensed bank or payment app does that, only after a person approves.

action.description: The payment the agent proposes: {merchant, vpa, lines: [{name, qty, unit, price}], fees, total}.

ap2.description: Optional, instead of intent and action: AP2 (Agent Payments Protocol) mandates {intent_mandate, cart_mandate, payment_mandate} (or the A2A data parts keyed ap2.mandates.*). Checked only; Nityaflow is not a payment party.

history.description: Earlier payments under this mandate: [{at, total, vpa, status: paid}]. Used for the period limit and repeat check.

intent.description: What the person asked for: {text, items: [{name, qty, unit}], budget, merchant}. Units: kg, g, l, ml, pc, pack, dozen.

mandate.description: The permission: {authorised_by, purpose, per_payment, per_period, period (day, week, month or 90 days), merchants: [{name, vpa, category}], approve_above, valid_from, valid_to}.

review_token.description: For stage confirm: the review_token from the review step, unchanged.

stage.description: review (default): check the cart and get a signed review_token. confirm: right before paying, send the same mandate, intent and action with the review_token; Nityaflow stops if anything changed, if it is late, or if the review was already used.

name: agent_payment_check
title: Check an AI agent's payment against the mandate and the instruction
